_note: Single-source (Japanese, Sengoku Jidai period). Japonic sub-palette of the East Asian family; warring-states daimyo houses, samurai retainers, castle-towns and kami-shrines. clan = clanhold (the Tenno reigns, the Shogun and daimyo rule). Even split Lawful/Chaotic, no Neutral (the disciplined warrior-way vs the wild war-fury and the untamed kami). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Japanese register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are wholly NATIVE kami (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.japonic) - they do NOT borrow the Chinese forms (the tongues are unrelated) and are never real Shinto kami.

phonology.palette: Japonic: open CV moras (only coda -n); five vowels a i u e o; pitch accent; no consonant clusters; rendaku (sequential voicing) in compounds; clan(-shi/uji) + given; kami honorifics -no-kami/-no-mikoto/-hime.
phonology.phonotactics: strict CV moras, vowel-final; rendaku in compounds.

morphology.patronymic_form: the clan/house name (uji / -shi) precedes the given name; -no- links clan and name (X no Y); house-suffix -ke for the noble house.
morphology.compounding_rule: [clan] no [given]; toponyms = feature/quality + type: Kuro-yama (black-mountain), Aka-shiro (red-castle); rendaku voicing (kawa -> -gawa).

title_ladder.government: clanhold (the Sengoku warring-states: daimyo houses and their samurai retainers; the Tenno reigns in name, the Shogun and daimyo rule in fact)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Japonic clanhold, ascending. The Tenno (heavenly sovereign) reigns over Tenka (all-under-heaven) but the Shogun (military overlord, the Bakufu) and the Daimyo houses rule in fact; the Sengoku is the war of the daimyo. Kokushu (province-master) principality; Shugo (province-governor) county; Shugodai (border deputy) march; Jito (estate-lord) barony. (Rank titles are the real Japanese register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: clan/house name (uji/-shi) first, then given name; samurai add a title or the -no- form (X no Y); a gen-puku adult name for warriors.
surname_source: Buddhist or art-name (-an) for the cultured
people_name_convention.dual_register: the buke (warrior houses) carry a clan name + court/military title; commoners use a single name or trade-name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the native kami and warrior-virtues + an element: -maru (child/blade), Take- (valor), Kami- (divine): e.g. Takebimaru, names honoring Terashi-no-kami.

religion._note: Deity-names are NATIVE kami, independently coined (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.japonic) - they do NOT borrow the Chinese forms (the tongues are unrelated) and are never real Shinto kami. Lawful/Chaotic: the Lawful keep the ordered way of the warrior (the kami of sun, blade and ancestors); the Chaotic the wild kami and the war-fury (the storm, the war-flame, the mountain-oni). The kami pervade all things; the ancestral dead (senzo) are honored at the household shrine.
religion.the_one: Takami-no-kami (< the One, Aeternus, rendered as native kami; the High-Heaven One, distant above the myriad kami)

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Terashi-no-kami (the Shining One, sun and right-rule)
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Hagane-no-kami (the Steel One, the blade-oath and war)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the wild and devouring powers are fierce kami or oni, each with an epithet: Maraxus -> Takebi-no-kami the War-Flame; Vacidus -> Utsuro-no-kami the Devouring Void; Lusanto -> Kogane-Orochi the gold hoard-serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Jinja (shrine) of [kami]: 'the Jinja of Terashi-no-kami', within its torii and sacred grove.
religion.saints_pattern: great ancestors and fallen heroes enshrined as kami (the eirei, honored dead) at the clan jinja; 'the kami [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Terashi-no-kami: a rising sun-disc above a mirror and sword
holy_symbol_motifs.Hagane-no-kami: a bare blade crossed before a torii

banks_patterns.ships: war-junk and atakebune names: 'the Wave-Cutter', 'the Storm-Crane', 'Hagane-maru'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [clan] Gun (host) / the [color] Sonae (battle-formation): 'the Crimson Sonae', 'the Tiger Gun'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen shiro (castles) and abandoned jinja: 'the ruined Shiro of [clan]', 'the haunted Jinja of [name]'
